columns.title: Total Cost Basis
columns.formula: IF(ISBLANK({Buy Price}), 0, {Buy Price}) + IF(ISBLANK({Parts Invested}), 0, {Parts Invested})

columns.title: Net Profit
columns.formula: IF(ISBLANK({Sold Price}), 0, {Sold Price}) - IF(ISBLANK({Buy Price}), 0, {Buy Price}) - IF(ISBLANK({Parts Invested}), 0, {Parts Invested})

columns.title: Complete?
columns.formula: IF(AND(LEN({Receipt}&"")>0, LEN({Timestamp}&"")>0, LEN({Table Written}&"")>0, LEN({Record Ref}&"")>0, LEN({Action}&"")>0, LEN({Actor}&"")>0, LEN({Status}&"")>0, LEN({Fields Touched}&"")>0), "OK", CONCAT("INCOMPLETE -- missing: ", IF(LEN({Receipt}&"")==0,"Receipt ",""), IF(LEN({Timestamp}&"")==0,"Timestamp ",""), IF(LEN({Table Written}&"")==0,"TableWritten ",""), IF(LEN({Record Ref}&"")==0,"RecordRef ",""), IF(LEN({Action}&"")==0,"Action ",""), IF(LEN({Actor}&"")==0,"Actor ",""), IF(LEN({Status}&"")==0,"Status ",""), IF(LEN({Fields Touched}&"")==0,"FieldsTouched ","")))
